steps.step: Send Simone a very short CISO brief, a few lines on read-level query logging and masked unblinded columns with expiring role grants, to forward whenever Dr. Okafor has time. (owner Marta Kowal, due 2026-10-01). Why: CISO sign-off is the gate, and she skips long documents. A typical AE would attach the full recap or push for a meeting.

judge.critique: Strong step; the weakest point is that it omits the economic buyer (VP of R and D or procurement, threshold unknown) and the fact that Dr. Okafor's calendar is deferred, so adding an offer to Simone to supply what the CISO review needs by a customer-set date, plus asking who signs commercially, would round it out.

steps.step: Ask Simone to find out whether procurement and the VP of R and D approve at this deal size, and who signs, so the economic buyer is named before any commercial talk. (owner Marta Kowal, due 2026-10-02). Why: Simone said it in passing and was unsure of the threshold. The CRM economic buyer is blank and easy to leave that way.

judge.critique: Weakest is r2: the real blocker is Dr. Okafor's CISO sign-off and her unavailable calendar, not the commercial approver, so fix it by leading with a short audit-trail and unblinded-access brief Simone can forward to her, and treat the economic buyer question as secondary.
